harness_pin_mapping.fact: standard 40P CABLINE-CA harnesses 82652 (100 mm) and 82653 (300 mm) connect connector-1 position n to connector-2 position 41-n (PIN ASSIGNMENT table: 40->1, 39->2, ..., 2->39, 1->40)
harness_pin_mapping.plug: CABLINE-CA plug 20633-240T-01S, connector to be mated 20525-040E-02
harness_pin_mapping.harness_limits: rating voltage 30 V; harness operating temperature 80 degC max (harness drawing notes 3-4)

sh_land_classification.shell_tabs: 4 lands G/H: side tabs of item 3 SHELL (dwg20525 sheet 1/7 top view outline; sheet 6/7 shows the shell tab feet on the pads with reference (0.20) insets)
sh_land_classification.end_tails: 2 lands A: pointed solder tails drawn continuous with the shell outline in the sheet 1/7 top view and sheet 2/7 bottom view; not separately itemised
sh_land_classification.ground_contacts: 6 lands K/E: the six contacts of the sheet 2/7 bottom view whose feet sit 0.25 behind the signal row inside the sheet 5/7 'GND AREA'; catalog advertises 'EMI shielding and multi-point ground design'
sh_land_classification.pin_assignment: all 12 lands use number SH and pin SHIELD (ground/passive); the shared number does not claim an internal connection: no internal_pad_groups is declared, so every SH land must be routed to the ground net

corrections_to_preliminary_reading: The right-hand '0.80 +/-0.03' on sheet 5/7 is the signal-pad length, not the Note 1 area offset. The Note 1 area top is only given as '3.42 MIN.' from the lower shell-pad top edge, i.e. at least 0.82 above the signal-pad outer edge; the courtyard uses that minimum.

The sheet 5/7 view is a generic drawing (5 ground pads with one on the centre line); the 40P count comes from the table: E/K+1 = 6, symmetric (+/-1.2, +/-3.6, +/-6.0), no pad on the centre line, matching sheet 2/7.
The metal-mask layout repeats every copper dimension 1:1 (no split shell apertures); only the 0.12 mm stencil thickness is additional.
Sheet 1/7 5.30 is the mated receptacle+plug depth, not the receptacle body; the body envelope is D=21.20 x 4.15 (tail tip to body bottom), placed with the sheet 6/7 reference (0.35) tail-tip inset.
Sheet 2/7 is an unlabelled bottom view; it does not name the six contacts 'ground'.
unresolved: Whether the six ground contacts are formed from item 3 SHELL or are separate contacts (the BOM lists only housing, contact and shell; sheet 2/7 draws them as separate outlines); any permanent internal connection between ground-contact, end-tail and shell lands is therefore unestablished and none is declared.
End-tail identity as part of the shell relies on outline continuity, not a label.
Position 1 is inferred from the datum-mark convention plus harness POS.1 labels; no I-PEX document labels receptacle POS.1 directly.
F.Fab body Y placement uses parenthesised reference dimensions from sheet 6/7; F.SilkS marker, F.Fab datum/cable arrow and line widths are CopperLib conventions.
Courtyard top uses the 3.42 MIN. minimum; the Note 1 keep-out applies only when a pull-bar plug (20633-#**T-01S) is used, but it is applied unconditionally.

Note 2 GND AREA outline on Dwgs.User follows the hatch boundary read from sheet 5/7 (H wide; top at 0.55 below the signal line outside the end pads, at the ground-pad top line between them; bottom at the Note 1 bottom); it is documentation only.
Per-position signal/ground use is a harness/board decision; the receptacle assigns none. 50 ohm micro-coax SI, EMC and assembly process are not qualified.
